annotations.title: Check: prove the paying wallet and screen it

description: Hand here the signature of check_buy_challenge with its nonce and message, unchanged. The challenge is consumed once, the wallet goes through the free screening (OFAC, issuer freezes), and only if it passes it returns { buyProof (vcb_..., 10 minutes, secret), payer, screening: passed, expiresAt }. A blocked wallet gets payer_blocked (403). A challenge of another kind (check_access_challenge, destination_challenge) is refused with check_buy_challenge_invalid. Pass buyProof to check_charge.

signature.description: EVM: the EIP-191 or EIP-712 signature. Solana: the ed25519 signature in base58.

transaction.description: Solana: the signed proofTransaction (base64), never sent.

name: check_buy_proof
